_comment: Approved media for the site. ccVideo is the ~60-second Continuous Certification video. It renders (home page and /certified, top of the Continuous Certification block) ONLY when src is a same-origin file under /media/ and approvedBy and approvedOn are recorded. Captions per locale: { "en": "/media/cc-60s.en.vtt", ... }. No third-party embeds (the site CSP and the privacy notice assume none).
